async def act(page):
    # Use the knowledge_base function to navigate to the project details page
    await navigate_to_project_details(page, 'Byte Blaze / a11y-syntax-highlighting')
    # After navigation, wait for the page to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Now, on the project details page, click the 'Issues' link to go to the issues list
    # Assuming the issues link is accessible via role 'link' with name containing 'Issues'
    issues_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Issues')
    await issues_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Click the 'New issue' button to create a new issue
    new_issue_button = page.get_by_role('link', name='New issue')
    await new_issue_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Fill in the issue title
    title_input = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Title')
    await title_input.fill('Support for Llama and Llama family models in metaseq')
    # Fill in the issue description
    description_input = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Description')
    await description_input.fill('What is the plan for supporting Llama and other Llama family models in metaseq? Please provide details on timelines, implementation, and any related updates.')
    # Submit the issue
    submit_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Submit issue')
    await submit_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
